about: Lab PR 236 (multi-match) over lab PR 235: a root process staged in /tmp reads a GPG private key and connects out, and its exec record reaches the engine last. NN-L-CHAIN-001 fires on the connect; on the late exec NN-L-CHAIN-007 completes the three-step chain, which used to silence the exec's own rules. Now the exec's record names CHAIN-007 (Critical, primary) with R001 and R009, one kill of the tree.

decision.name: GPG keyring accessed by non-GnuPG process
decision.reasoning: GPG keyring accessed by a process outside the GnuPG toolchain — MITRE T1552.004; posture → ENGAGED

decision.name: Credential-store access followed by network egress
decision.reasoning: Process accessed a credential store and then opened an outbound flow within the correlation window — credential exfiltration (T1555 → T1041); kill the process tree + posture → COMBAT [also matched: NN-L-NET-001_OutboundToBlockedIp (KillProcessTree, Critical), NN-L-NET-008_OutboundFromTmpExec (KillProcess, High)] [judged at the connect, while the flow is open (lab PR 224)]

decision.name: /tmp exec then credential read then egress (3-step)
decision.reasoning: Process executed from a staging directory, then read a credential store, then opened an outbound flow (the exec was processed after the read and the flow, in kernel order before them) — three-step dropper → credential-access → exfil chain (T1059 → T1555 → T1041); kill the process tree + posture → COMBAT [also matched: R009_RootExecFromUserPath (KillProcessTree, High), R001_ExecFromTmp (KillProcessTree, Medium)]
